I can't compute these numbers because the data isn't in the working directory.

I searched `/tmp/r2run-srp65m6k`. It holds only shell and editor configuration files (`.bashrc`, `.zshrc`, `.gitconfig`, `.mcp.json` and similar) and a `.claude` settings folder. It has no IURC orders, no case data, and no PDFs or spreadsheets covering the 58 orders from 2021 to 2025. I was told to use only files in this directory, so I didn't look elsewhere or try to fetch the orders from the web.

I also won't give an estimate. Any figure for the 2023 and 2024 shares would be invented, not derived from data.

I need the 58 orders, or a table extracted from them, placed in the working directory. The table would need the order date, respondent, cite and recommendation text for each case. With that I can compute all four percentages: the share of non-utility cases with a headline penalty of at least $5,000 in 2023 and 2024, and the utility share of all cases in each year.
